'''Dave Morello''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 34 and a Flight Leader in the Corellia region, from Royal Oak, Michigan. His slot was later marked Retired.<ref name="smlist" /> He ran tournaments at stores across Southeast Michigan and helped organize events at Motor City Comic Con, U-Con, WinterCon and MichCon. He was a Ford brake engineer.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/morellodave.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 34 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001212215500/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/morellodave.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
